name: People Hurting You
overview: Scripture assures believers that even when those closest to us forsake or hurt us, the LORD faithfully gathers and upholds us with His righteous hand, offering strength and help in times of fear and distress. God is near to the brokenhearted and saves those with a contrite spirit, promising peace and an expected future beyond present suffering. Jesus teaches that enduring false accusations and persecution for His sake brings blessing, while reminding us that with God, nothing is impossible.
